text:
Sophie: Seeing a bunch of 502s hitting hosted inference gateway for a handful of tenants since ~08:15 UTC. Customers reporting failed generations and timeouts.
Ryan: Yep, getting alerts. Spike in gateway 502 rate from proxy -> control-plane calls.
Maya: Any immediate impact on billing or token charging? Customers say requests are retried and double-billing maybe.
Eli: Billing service shows retries logged but we haven't attributed double charge yet. I'll flag finance, but first we need a mitigation.
infra-bot: alert: hosted-gateway-proxy 502-rate=0.8% (5m), routing-policy 504-rate increased, configdb read latency p95 1200ms
Sophie: Root cause trace I started: proxy->routing-policy svc -> config-db read timed out (500ms backend) -> routing-policy returns 502 to gateway. Logs attached below.
Sophie: log snippet:
```
[2025-11-07T08:17:02Z] routing-policy: GET /v1/route?tenant=tenant-acme -> configdb.Read timeout after 450ms
[2025-11-07T08:17:02Z] routing-policy: upstream error: svc/configdb timeout
[2025-11-07T08:17:02Z] routing-policy: returning 502 to caller
```
Ryan: That matches traces I pulled — distributed trace shows correlation id 7b3a.. returns 502 at routing-policy. configdb pool exhausted on some nodes.
Maya: Any recent deploys to routing-policy or configdb? Could be a rollout gone wrong.
Eli: No routing-policy deploys in last 24h. There was a configdb schema migration 03:00 UTC but it was small (index add). Rollout logs looked green.
oncall-sre: Looking at DB metrics — sudden increase in read latency and connection count at 08:12 UTC on configdb-primary. Connection pool at 98% for a few minutes.
Sophie: Could be thundering reads from a cache miss pattern. Are we seeing cache eviction or a cache key change?
Ryan: I see a TTL change for routing-policy in the config service: a patch changed ttl from 5m to 10s at 07:58 UTC for some tenants. PR #4521 by ops-automation.
Maya: That would cause a storm of cache refreshes. If many requests hit simultaneously they'd all pressure configdb.
Eli: Confirmed: ops-automation applied a feature flag to lower cache TTL during a test. It targeted a small tenant list but config rollout included wildcard. Oops.
Sophie: OK mitigation options: 1) revert TTL change; 2) increase configdb read pool / fail open cache; 3) enable routing-policy local in-memory fallback cache.
oncall-sre: For immediate relief, I'll throttle requests from gateway to routing-policy for bursters and enable local fallback (serve last-known route) for 30s.
Ryan: Also set routing-policy to return cached-stale route if configdb times out instead of 502. We have a circuit-breaker flag in prod: `ROUTE_ON_CONFIGDB_TIMEOUT=true`.
Maya: I'm patching the feature-flag rollback PR now. Rolling back TTL change and re-deploying feature flags.
Eli: Finance note: hold billing reconciliation until retried requests are deduped. I'll open a ticket with billing ops: BILL-5432.
Sophie: Repro steps for SRE postmortem:
1) curl proxy endpoint with tenant-acme load (ab) to simulate
2) cause cache TTL to 10s (env var) and watch configdb connection pool
3) run trace and capture correlation id
Logs/commands:
```
ab -n 1000 -c 50 https://hosted-api.redwood.ai/v1/tenant-acme/generate
kubectl -n controlplane logs deployment/routing-policy --since=10m | grep "configdb.Read timeout"
```
oncall-sre: Applying immediate mitigations: throttling rule applied on gateway (burst cap 20r/s per tenant), routing-policy flag set to serve stale-on-error, rollback PR queued and will be promoted in 2m.
Sophie: Customer comms: support to send holding message to affected tenants: "We're investigating intermittent 502s; mitigation applied; we will follow up with root cause and timeline." Use template: https://redwood.example/comm-templates/502-hold.md
Maya: Rollback complete and feature flags reverted. Configdb connections decreasing, routing-policy 502 rate back to 0.02%.
Eli: Billing ops acked — they will scan for duplicate charge patterns and reverse if needed. Ticket BILL-5432 created.
Ryan: Postmortem items: - tighten change rollout gating for cache TTLs - add canary that validates cache TTL patch won't target wildcard tenants - add rate-limiter fallback in routing-policy - add alert for configdb pool > 80% sustained
Sophie: Thanks team. I'll open an incident writeup and link traces + commands. Assigning to oncall-sre and infra for follow-up.
oncall-sre: Got it. I'll start the incident doc and schedule a 1hr RCA tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Sophie: Closing thread here — if anything else pops up ping #incidents.
